items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of physical, logical and secure-destruction measures, plus the five key IT Acts every professional must know.

items.title: Password Cracking — Computerphile
items.description: Shows exactly how attackers break weak passwords — makes the case for strong logical prevention measures in vivid detail.

items.title: Secure Web Browsing — Computerphile
items.description: Computerphile explains encryption and browser security — key prevention concepts that link to the Data Protection Act.

items.title: What Is Firewall? | Firewall Explained — Simplilearn
items.description: Clear explanation of one of the most important logical prevention measures — firewalls — with diagrams.

items.title: Hackers (1995)
items.description: Classic 90s thriller following teenage hackers — a fun way to see what motivates attackers and why prevention laws were needed.

items.title: Computer Misuse Act 1990 — legislation.gov.uk
items.description: The full text of the Computer Misuse Act — see exactly what the law says about unauthorised access and hacking.

items.title: Data Protection Act 2018 — legislation.gov.uk
items.description: The primary UK data protection legislation — key reading for understanding the legal framework around personal data.

items.title: NCSC — Phishing: Spot and Report Scams
items.description: Official NCSC guidance on spotting phishing attacks — practical supplement to the prevention measures in this lesson.
